about.description: TeMFpy (Tensor Networks for Mean-Field States in Python, suggested pronuncation: ˈtɛmɸ.paɪ) is a TeNPy-based Python library for converting fermionic mean-field states to finite or infinite matrix product state form. TeMFpy includes new, efficient, and easy-to-understand algorithms for both Slater determinants and Pfaffian states. Together with Gutzwiller projection, these also allow the user to build variational wave functions for various strongly correlated electron systems, such as quantum spin liquids. Being built on top of TeNPy, it integrates seamlessly with existing MPS-based algorithms.
about.summary: TeMFpy (Tensor Networks for Mean Field States in Python) is a library for converting mean-field fermionic wavefunctions into matrix product states (MPS).

name: temfpy
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.3.3"

package:
  name: temfpy
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/temfpy/temfpy/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a7b66a28ab7fa4a351e0a16e0607f3ba2a0ce0f4e5d4ea277405db0ab3d5afcf

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script:
    env:
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}
    content: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - scipy
    - physics-tenpy >=1.1.0
    - pfapack

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - temfpy
      # The win-64 pfapack package lacks distribution metadata,
      # so pip cannot detect it even though it is installed.
      pip_check: ${{ false if win else true }}
      python_version:
        # physics-tenpy has no win-64 builds for Python <3.12 
        - if: win
          then: "3.12.*"
          else: ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://temfpy.github.io/temfpy/
  summary: TeMFpy (Tensor Networks for Mean Field States in Python) is a library for converting mean-field fermionic wavefunctions into matrix product states (MPS).
  description: |
    TeMFpy (Tensor Networks for Mean-Field States in Python, suggested pronuncation: ˈtɛmɸ.paɪ) is a TeNPy-based Python library for converting fermionic mean-field states to finite or infinite matrix product state form. TeMFpy includes new, efficient, and easy-to-understand algorithms for both Slater determinants and Pfaffian states. Together with Gutzwiller projection, these also allow the user to build variational wave functions for various strongly correlated electron systems, such as quantum spin liquids. Being built on top of TeNPy, it integrates seamlessly with existing MPS-based algorithms.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://temfpy.github.io/temfpy/
  repository: https://github.com/temfpy/temfpy

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - temfpy
    - simonhille
    - attila-i-szabo
